clue.text: Calculation by girl without delay

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetical calculation
Mary is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A sum worked out by a girl in no time at all.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective, summary means done at once, with no formalities or waiting, as in summary justice.

clue.text: Son with great taste

parts.note: ample means large or plentiful

explanation.surface: A son praised for his excellent taste.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to sample food is to try it, which is to taste it.

clue.text: Could pay, putting away father's stout

indicators.note: putting away means removing letters from the phrase

parts.note: could pay may be expressed as might pay
PA is a familiar word for father

explanation.surface: Someone who could afford to put away Dad's bottle of stout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stout' looks like the beer that father puts away, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Stout can mean strong and powerful, as in a stout defender, a synonym for powerful.

clue.text: Lacy shifts worn by one in church without any slips

indicators.note: worn by places the clergyman inside the shuffled letters, as clothes go round a body
shifts says the letters of lacy are moved about

parts.note: a curate is an assistant member of the clergy

explanation.surface: A clergyman in a frilly shift, careful not to slip.
explanation.walkthrough: Slips and shifts both pose as underwear; 'shifts' is the anagram signal and 'worn by' wraps its result around the clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something accurately means doing it precisely, with no errors.

clue.text: Little child in capsized river vessel

indicators.note: in says the child goes inside the overturned river
capsized in a down clue means the river's letters are turned upside down

parts.note: the Tay is a Scottish river
CH is the abbreviation for child

explanation.surface: A small child in a boat that has overturned on a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A yacht is a sailing boat, a kind of vessel.

clue.text: Pieces of equipment editor returned with defects

indicators.note: returned says the editor's letters are sent back the other way

parts.note: vices are faults or defects of character

explanation.surface: Faulty kit is sent back by an editor along with a list of its defects.
explanation.definitionFit: Devices are gadgets or contrivances, which are items of apparatus.

clue.text: Sought-after in hotel bar, I sedately turned up

indicators.note: turned up says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A popular hotel bar where someone arrives at a leisurely pace.
explanation.walkthrough: The run of letters sits inside 'hotel bar, I sedately' and in this down clue 'turned up' reads them from the bottom upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Desirable means wanted or coveted, which is what sought-after means.

clue.text: Struggle over wife's opinion

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the struggle above the wife

parts.note: to vie is to compete or struggle

explanation.surface: A tussle about what a wife thinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A view is a way of seeing things, a point of view or belief.

clue.text: Religious person caught cold hosting at Hindu festival

indicators.note: hosting means the two letters hold the rest between them

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
Holi is the Hindu spring festival of colours

explanation.surface: A believer who comes down with a cold at an Indian festival.
explanation.definitionFit: A Catholic is a member of the Roman Catholic Church, a person of a particular faith.

clue.text: Feel restricting American power creates tension

indicators.note: restricting means the feel word closes in on the other letters

parts.note: to sense is to feel
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: Restraints on American power produce international tension.
explanation.definitionFit: Suspense is anxious uncertainty while waiting for an outcome, a state of nervous strain.

clue.text: Cool US soldier in rain gear

indicators.note: in says the soldier sits inside the raincoat

parts.note: a mac is a mackintosh, a raincoat
GI is an American private soldier

explanation.surface: A stylish American serviceman wearing his raincoat.
explanation.definitionFit: Magic is informal slang for excellent or terrific, much as cool is used approvingly.

clue.text: Film magazines? Put tons in boxes

indicators.note: in places put-plus-tons inside the boxes

parts.note: cases are boxes or containers
to set something is to put or place it

explanation.surface: Instructions to pack film periodicals and heavy goods into crates.
explanation.definitionFit: A cassette is a sealed cartridge holding film or tape, which a camera loads like a magazine; the question mark flags the pun on periodicals.

clue.text: Temptation to pinch one three times to reveal texts

indicators.note: to pinch is to grip between the fingers, so the temptation's letters hold the rest

parts.note: a lure is an enticement or temptation
I is the Roman numeral one
times gives T, ERA and T in turn: T is the abbreviation for time and an era is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Someone tempted to steal while checking the evidence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'three times' asks for three separate words for time: T, then ERA, then T again.
explanation.definitionFit: Literature is the body of written works, so texts collectively make it up.

clue.text: Message school sent back

indicators.note: sent back means the school's name is read in reverse

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: A school returns a message to a parent.
explanation.definitionFit: A note is a short written communication or memo.

clue.text: Criminal corpse is on file

indicators.note: criminal suggests these letters are crooked and need putting straight

explanation.surface: A police file records a body found in suspicious circumstances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'file' looks like a dossier noun but means a line of people walking one behind another.
explanation.definitionFit: A procession is a line of people moving forward in order, as in single file.

clue.text: Brewer's art is transforming fruit

indicators.note: transforming means the brewer's letters are being changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A brewer's craft turning fruit into drink, as in fruit beers.
explanation.definitionFit: Strawberries are a familiar soft red summer fruit.

clue.text: Abigail fibs about information technology skills

parts.note: Abi is a short form of the name Abigail

indicators.note: about means the fibs go round the computing letters

parts.note: lies are fibs

explanation.surface: Abigail exaggerates her computer skills on her CV.
explanation.definitionFit: Abilities are talents or capacities, a direct synonym for skills.

clue.text: They could box her gifts for a change

indicators.note: for a change says the letters of her gifts are altered in order

explanation.surface: Someone might pack her presents in a box, just for a change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'box' pretends to be packing gifts; here it means fight with fists.
explanation.definitionFit: Boxers are those who fight in the ring, so people who could box are combatants.

clue.text: Is shedding one lock of hair? Edward's worried

indicators.note: shedding means dropping a letter from the word is

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a tress is a long lock of hair
Ed is short for Edward

explanation.surface: Edward is anxious because he is losing his hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Stressed means under strain and anxious, which is close to worried.

clue.text: Neglect lie-in being disturbed, seeing news

indicators.note: being disturbed says these letters are shaken out of their order

explanation.surface: Someone skips a lie-in after being woken by the morning headlines.
explanation.definitionFit: Intelligence means information, especially of military or political value, which is news received.

clue.text: Jeer and jeer mistake, childishly

parts.note: boo is a jeer of disapproval
a second boo, another jeer

explanation.surface: A crowd jeers twice at a childish error.
explanation.definitionFit: Boo-boo is a nursery-style word for a silly blunder, so it is a childish way of saying error.

clue.text: Delicate offer

definitions.meaning: fragile or easily hurt, as in soft to the touch
to put forward formally, as in a bid or a resignation

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both soft or fragile, and to put forward a formal bid or proposal.

clue.text: Tilt part of body

definitions.meaning: a ship ... when it leans over to one side
the back part of the foot

explanation.surface: Leaning over on one foot.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a ship leaning to one side and the rear of the human foot.

clue.text: Dodgy crime scoop — it makes things seem bigger than they really are

definitions.text: it makes things seem bigger than they really are

indicators.note: dodgy means unreliable or shady, so the letters of the scoop are not to be trusted in their order

explanation.surface: A tabloid's crime exclusive that exaggerates the story.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads like a jibe at sensational journalism, but it describes a magnifying instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A microscope is an optical instrument that magnifies small objects so they look larger.

clue.text: King perhaps left after game with the Queen

indicators.note: after says the left letter comes after the game

parts.note: RU is rugby union
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A king plays rugby with his queen and then leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A king is one example of a sovereign who governs, hence the perhaps.

clue.text: Plant expert secures stake

indicators.note: secures says the words hold the answer locked inside them

explanation.surface: A botanist ties a plant to a supporting stake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stake' reads as a garden support but means a poker bet.
explanation.definitionFit: An ante is the stake each poker player puts in before the deal.

clue.text: Important German city — it is round a lake

parts.note: Essen is a city in the Ruhr

indicators.note: round says the word it is turned about

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A notable German city, said to be set around a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Essential means vital or of the greatest importance.

clue.text: Looking from the East, name part of UK that's ready to blossom

indicators.note: in an across clue, looking from the east means reading from right to left

parts.note: to dub someone is to give them a name
NI is Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A view across the water from the east to a part of the UK just coming into flower.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant in bud has formed buds that have not yet opened, so it is about to flower.

clue.text: Low quality?

parts.note: not poor standard, but the state of feeling low, that is down or unhappy

explanation.surface: Something of poor standard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Low quality' suggests shoddiness; read it as the quality of being low in spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorrow or unhappiness is being low in spirits, so it is the quality of feeling down.

clue.text: Dashed dog, having nothing to eat, shows resentment

parts.note: dashed means ran quickly

indicators.note: to eat says the dog takes the nothing inside itself

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
O, the zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: A hungry dog runs off without its dinner and sulks.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is bitter, long-lasting resentment or ill will.
